failing_checks.title: Account authority changes
failing_checks.reason: Contract-admin change is gated by require_auth only when an admin is already stored. Before initialization, any caller can set the admin. set_minter is gated by admin auth (line 72), so minter changes are controlled once an admin exists. Admin takeover before setup is already recorded.
